scope: Complete v5 Manifest, source contract, actual package bytes, trust verification, immutable package identity, primary CLI and rebuilt examples

paths.target: Actual built primary CLI, independent SHA-256/Ed25519 in both directions, unsigned/revoked/trailing/no-overwrite rejection

boundaries.production_host_capabilities: Empty until03c Dispatcher; published extension DTO metadata is not an available runtime provider.
boundaries.release_index: Host-owned in-process immutable package identity index; durable install/operation state and recovery semantics belong to03b.
boundaries.legacy_types: Historical Manager/storage/inspection types remain until03b; production entry paths do not parse, adapt, discover, install or execute old packages.
boundaries.ui: PDF source rebuilt as v5 package; dynamic UI/Bridge mounting belongs to04, existing original-resource downloads remain separate.
boundaries.runtime: WASI bytes built and verified, pinned OCI declaration validated without pulling; executing either adapter belongs to05/06.

future_stage_ownership.V12-03c: Dispatcher, callable capabilities and provider registration
